finePrint.summary: Lifetime-deal buyers get a total lifetime allowance of 50,000–450,000 mentions, not monthly resets.

quote.text: All lifetime-deal plans come with a lifetime limit of keyword monitoring ranging from 50,000–450,000 mentions.

finePrint.summary: Once the lifetime mention allowance is used, buyers must pay extra for more mentions.

quote.text: Additional mentions can be bought at $5/2,000 mentions.

finePrint.summary: Buyers can get a full refund within the first 30 days after purchase.

quote.text: If, for any reason, you are not completely satisfied with our product within the first 30 days of your purchase, you can request a full refund.

finePrint.summary: Lifetime deals include a 30-day money-back guarantee for any dissatisfaction reason.

quote.text: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on lifetime deals if you feel you are not satisfied with the product for any reason.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can suspend or terminate access at any time without notice or liability.

quote.text: We reserve the right to terminate or suspend your access to our services, without prior notice or liability, for any reason, including without limitation if you breach the Terms and Conditions.

finePrint.summary: All LTD tiers receive priority support via live chat and email.

quote.text: Priority support access is given to all tiers of LTD users through our live support chat and email at hello@bizreply.co.

finePrint.summary: Extra mention credit pricing is locked forever for LTD customers.

quote.text: Simple: buy more anytime at these exact rates. Your LTD status means this pricing is yours forever.

finePrint.summary: LTD buyers must supply their own AI model key for replies.

quote.text: Use your preferred AI model. All LTD plans support BYOK for Claude, OpenAI, Open Router, Gemini and Straico.
